papers.title: Greenhouse gas responses to coastal wetland land use change vary by ecosystem and conversion pathway
papers.abstract: This study shows that greenhouse gas responses to coastal wetland land use change depend on the original ecosystem and conversion pathway, highlighting the climate value of conserving vegetated wetlands and targeting restoration.
papers.titleZh: 沿海溼地土地利用變遷的溫室氣體反應隨生態系與轉化途徑而異
papers.summaryZh: 本研究顯示，沿海溼地土地利用變遷所產生的溫室氣體反應，取決於原有的生態系以及轉化途徑。這項發現凸顯了保育植被溼地以及針對性復育對於氣候的價值。研究結果有助於理解溫室氣體與溼地變遷之間的關聯。

papers.title: Shape conforming Janus hydrogel for preventing anastomotic leaks
papers.abstract: Anastomotic leaks remain a major complication of gastrointestinal surgery, yet existing sealants often fail to provide durable coverage of irregular tissue surfaces. Here, the authors develop a Janus powder-derived dressing composed of an adhesive porous layer mechanically interlocked with a non-adhesive backing. The material conforms to anastomotic tissues, resists unwanted post-surgical adhesions, and provides sustained sealing, offering a promising strategy for leak prevention and repair.
papers.titleZh: 可塑形 Janus 水凝膠預防吻合口滲漏
papers.summaryZh: 吻合口滲漏仍是胃腸道手術的重大併發症，而現有封填劑常無法對不規則組織表面提供持久覆蓋。作者開發出一種 Janus 粉末衍生的敷料，由具黏性的多孔層與非黏性背層機械互鎖而成。該材料可貼合吻合口組織，抵抗術後不必要的沾黏，並提供持續性密封。研究指出此設計為預防與修復滲漏提供一種有前景的策略。

papers.title: A global atlas of digital dermatology to map innovation and disparities
papers.abstract: The authors map 1.1 million dermatology images to assess the diversity of data used to train AI and find major gaps in darker skin tones and children, highlighting the importance of representation for future data collection.
papers.titleZh: 數位皮膚科全球圖譜：描繪創新與差異
papers.summaryZh: 作者建構了涵蓋110萬張皮膚科影像的全球圖譜，用以評估訓練人工智慧所使用的資料多樣性。研究發現資料中存在重大缺口，特別是在較深膚色族群與兒童族群的代表性不足。該圖譜旨在描繪數位皮膚科的創新現況與差異分布。結果凸顯代表性對未來資料收集的重要性。

papers.title: Landscape fire sourced PM2.5, cause-specific paediatric hospitalisations, and the role of tree cover
papers.abstract: Greater tree cover is associated with lower risks and burdens of landscape fire smoke-related hospitalisations in children and adolescents across seven countries and territories, suggesting potential benefits of expanding tree cover.
papers.titleZh: 樹木覆蓋與野火煙霧相關兒童住院風險
papers.summaryZh: 本研究探討景觀火源PM2.5、特定原因的兒科住院以及樹木覆蓋的角色。研究發現，樹木覆蓋較高與兒童及青少年因景觀火災煙霧相關的住院風險與負擔較低有關。該關聯是在七個國家和地區中觀察到。結果暗示擴大樹木覆蓋可能具有潛在益處。

paper.title: Accelerating high-throughput catalyst screening by direct generation of equilibrium adsorption structures
paper.abstract: The authors develop DBCata, a generative model trained without energy or force labels to produce near-equilibrium adsorption structures, enabling faster screening of candidate catalysts.

paper.title: Entropy-engineered polar heterogeneity enables near-decoupled polarization–strain behavior for high-density energy storage
paper.abstract: Strong polarization–strain coupling limits the energy density and reliability of lead-free dielectric capacitors. Here, the authors show that entropy-engineered polar heterogeneity weakens this coupling, enabling ultrahigh energy storage with minimal electrostrain.

paper.title: [c2]Daisy-chain molecular turing machines with switchable fluorescence outputs
paper.abstract: Synthetic small-molecule machines capable of bidirectionally reading and writing information on molecular tapes with visual output remain elusive due to the challenge in amplifying molecular-scale motions into macroscopic signals. Here, the authors report two [c2]daisy-chain molecular Turing machines that convert mechanical motions into fluorescence signals.

paper.title: Deep ultraviolet gallium-oxide avalanche photodiodes reaching an impulse-response-derived gain-bandwidth record of 152 GHz
paper.abstract: Solar-blind gallium oxide photodetectors enable secure deep-ultraviolet communication but face a trade-off between speed and gain. Dong et al. engineered a multilayer avalanche device achieving nanosecond response, high gain, and a record gain-bandwidth product.
